test: linear predictive proxy with tail-statistics increment
data: 12 controlled histories: H01/H02/H03 x SA/SB x fast/slow
protocol: fit source-independent current-window to next-window ridge predictor on fast-wind 0-180 s; train two-source nearest-centroid probe on fast 120-180 s; evaluate slow 180-240 s
interpretation: predictive proxy is window-scale sensitive rather than uniformly superior
tail statistics do not add a robust increment to predictive features here
the earlier H01 tail-feature rescue is insufficient for a general auxiliary-innovation claim
